details:
TEAM SPACE.P.A.C.T. has developed an interactive adventure game using Scratch. In the game, players control an astronaut named Jazzy, who is sent to Planet South by his boss. However, things do not go as planned when his rocket explodes after landing. Although he manages to fix it, something evil suddenly appears and destroys his only way back to Earth. With no other choice, Jazzy goes on a mission to find a way to fix his damaged ship. Along the way, he faces many obstacles and challenges that he needs to overcome.

The game works by allowing players to control Jazzy and help him complete his mission. Players have to pass different obstacles, make decisions and solve problems to move forward in the game.

One of the benefits of our project is that it helps players learn about space exploration and the challenges astronauts may face during their missions. It also helps improve creativity, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Our goal is to make learning about space more fun and interesting while helping players understand the difficulties of being an astronaut.

We used Scratch to create our game. It is a coding platform that allows us to create games using coding blocks, characters and backgrounds.

What makes our project creative is its storyline and gameplay. Instead of just giving players information about space, we created an adventure where they can experience some of the challenges themselves. We also included unexpected events and different obstacles to make the game more exciting.

During the development of our project, our team considered factors such as the difficulty of the game, the storyline, the players’ experience and the educational value. We wanted to make sure the game was fun and interesting without making it too difficult. Most importantly, we wanted players to enjoy the game while learning something new about space exploration.
